title: Assignment 3: Autonomous Robot Navigation in a Dynamic Office Environment
description: Compare two complete multi-floor routes using explicit obstacle detours, elevator delays, and destination-floor travel.
assignment_html:
Scenario

Purpose: Write a reusable comparison of two complete multi-floor robot routes.

A delivery robot starts at S = (5, 5) on floor 5 and must reach G = (25, 30) on floor 10. The displayed main route is S -> M1 -> M2 -> E_m. The service route goes straight to E_s plus one half-circle detour.

Task

Complete evaluate_elevator_routes(...) using its supplied speed, delay, floor, position, and waypoint parameters. Return these eight values in the starter order:

  1. Main entry path through every supplied waypoint.
  2. Service entry path plus pi * service_detour_radius.
  3. Main-elevator-to-goal distance.
  4. Service-elevator-to-goal distance.
  5. Complete main time.
  6. Complete service time.
  7. Exact label Main Elevator or Service Elevator.
  8. The matching smaller complete time.

total time = floor-5 path / speed + wait + floors * seconds per floor + floor-10 path / speed

Rules

  • Use Euclidean distance for straight segments and every supplied main waypoint.
  • Use the function parameters. The grader checks other building layouts and can make either elevator faster.
  • Do not change the function name, parameters, return order, or exact route labels.
  • Each of the eight equally weighted checks is worth 12.5%; the displayed total is rounded to the nearest whole percent.

Before you run the tests

  • Verify that both totals include entry travel, wait, elevator ride, and destination travel.
  • Verify that the route label and best time describe the same route.
learning_objectives: Calculate piecewise Euclidean routes through specified waypoints.
Model a stated half-circle obstacle detour without inventing additional geometry.
Combine horizontal travel, elevator wait, elevator ride, and destination-floor travel into a complete time.
Compare two route alternatives using the same complete cost model.

solution_html:
Floor 5

The main route follows S to M1 to M2 to E_m. The service route is its straight distance plus the stated half-circle detour.

Floor 10

For each option, include the straight distance from that elevator shaft to G.

Complete time

Add floor-5 walking time, elevator wait, five-floor ride time, and floor-10 walking time. The resulting totals are approximately 139.285 seconds through the main elevator and 147.399 seconds through the service elevator, so the Main Elevator is the faster complete route.
